def sanitize_filename(filename)
  # Use File.basename to prevent directory traversal attacks
  sanitized_filename = File.basename(filename)
  # Ensure the file has a valid extension (e.g., .mp3)
  if sanitized_filename.match?(/\A[\w,\s-]+\.(mp3|wav)\z/)
    sanitized_filename
  else
    nil
  end
end

# Example usage
filename = "../../etc/passwd"
sanitized = sanitize_filename(filename)
puts sanitized.nil? ? "Invalid filename" : "Sanitized filename: #{sanitized}"
